issue.title: Markdown link titles leak into minted dependent block IDs and relation notices
issue.description:
## Bug

- **Location:**  (, );  §11.7 and its SB vectors

A task description containing a Markdown link such as  is treated as plain phrase text by ; minting can produce an ID like .  also shows the raw Markdown link in relation and cancel notices. Reproduce by minting an ID and showing a relation/cancel notice for a task with a titled URL link.

This yields misleading task IDs and noisy notices. The mint pipeline is shared and pinned across engines, so fix it with coordinated SB-vector updates rather than changing only the plugin behavior.

task_type_fields.impact: Task IDs become misleading and relation/cancel notices are noisy. The shared cross-engine minting contract requires coordinated SB-vector updates.
task_type_fields.repro: Create a task containing a titled Markdown URL link such as [💡](https://keep.google.com/... "Open in Google Keep"), then mint its dependent block ID and display a relation or cancel notice. The minted ID can be ^https-keep-google-com and the notice includes the raw Markdown link.

issue.creation_reason: The approved relation investigation exposed this independent defect while reproducing a same-note relation failure. It requires a coordinated update to the pinned block-ID minting contract and belongs outside the line-shift fix.

Reproduce by minting an ID and showing a relation/cancel notice for a task with a titled URL link.

This yields misleading task IDs and noisy notices. The mint pipeline is shared and pinned across engines, so fix it with coordinated SB-vector updates rather than changing only the plugin behavior.
